content.subject: Fw: Thanks for doing the story

content.text:
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, October 10, 2018 9:11 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Thanks for doing the story

We’ve got things we need to iron out.
